verdict.rationale: Zep's graph search is hybrid, combining semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search, and developers can steer retrieval with a scope parameter (e.g. scope="auto" across edges, nodes, episodes, observations and summaries) and with custom entity/edge types; Graphiti also documents hybrid retrieval. The pack does not show metadata filtering, selectable reranking, or developer-switchable keyword-only versus hybrid modes. Missing for 10: metadata/attribute filter evidence, reranker options, explicit search-mode selection, independent hands-on corroboration.
